changed.title: Simultaneous relative counts for fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions at sizes a fixed fraction below the maximum
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let frame := fun j : Nat => j.bits.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
∃ (estimate : List Bool → List Bool) (degree : Nat), fast estimate ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
  let hist := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f ∧ size f = s}

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  ∀ (g b a : Nat), 1 ≤ g → 2 ≤ b → 1 ≤ a →
    let K := (5*(n+1)^4)^(g+1)
    let eligible := fun s : Nat => 0 < hist s ∧
      (hist (s-1) ≤ K*hist s ∨ ∃ lo hi : Nat,
        0 < hist lo ∧ 0 < hist hi ∧ (∀ j, 0 < hist j → lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi) ∧
        lo ≤ s ∧ s ≤ hi ∧ hi-lo ≤ g*(hi-s))
    let prefixBits := header g ++ header b ++ header a ++ input
    let ell := (prefixBits.length+2)^(degree*(g+1))
    let sizes := List.finRange (n/2+1)
    ∃ z : (Fin ell → Bool) → Fin (n/2+1) → Nat,
      (∀ tape, estimate (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape) =
        sizes.flatMap (fun s => frame (z tape s))) ∧
      (∀ tape s, z tape s = 0 ↔ hist s.val = 0) ∧
      2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool // ∀ s : Fin (n/2+1), eligible s.val →
        (4*b-4)*hist s.val ≤ z tape s ∧ z tape s ≤ (4*b+4)*hist s.val} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell

changed.context: Each output integer z represents z/(4b), where b is the unary accuracy parameter. Every tape emits zero exactly at empty sizes. One probability guarantee covers all eligible positive sizes.
changed.sketch: Compile signed samples to a shifted weighted matching histogram. Blossom gives the maximum supported size and the empty matching gives the exact initial count. Sweep the rational activities of the neighboring-mass lemma. Estimate size frequencies from the weighted matching chain. At a grid point where both neighbors are frequent, their ratio divided by the activity estimates the coefficient ratio. Telescope from the initial count. Log concavity puts every earlier ratio within the same cap. Budget relative errors across n ratios and failure over the whole grid. Clip to the exact support.
